description: Arcmira provides search and monitoring over YouTube and podcast transcripts, including passages, mentions, transcripts, sponsors, and monitors. It also publishes public documentation and entity pages for citing and reading indexed content.
summary: Arcmira exposes a bearer-authenticated HTTP JSON API at `api.arcmira.com/v1`, an OAuth-or-key authenticated remote MCP server at `mcp.arcmira.com/mcp`, a public docs MCP server at `arcmira.com/docs/mcp`, and an `arcmira` CLI that logs in interactively or uses the same API key.
